page_01.text_01: Use the arrow keys to navigate the menu and move in game
page_01.text_02: Use the [space] key to select in the menu and pause the game
page_01.text_03: Use the [esc] key to go back through the menus
page_01.text_05: Hold the [shift] key to focus, which adjusts the character speed and shot
page_01.text_06: Use the [x] key to use a bomb. Requires a spare bomb.
page_01.text_07: Use the [c] key to use a flash bomb. Requires a filled Graze Bar
page_01.text_08: Use the [a] or [z] key to advance dialogue
page_01.text_09: Hold the [s] or [x] key to skip through dialogue

page_02.text_10:
The number of spare Lives is counted in the Red Star Bars.
			Dying with zero spare lives lead to a game over.
			Gain more lives by collecting red Life Items.
page_02.text_11:
The number of bomb is counted in the Green Star Bars.
			Gain more bombs by collecting Bomb Items.
page_02.text_12:
The power level is tracked in the Red Power Bar.
			Gain power by collecting red Power Items.
page_02.text_13:
Current Graze is tracked in the Yellow Graze Bar and can overflow.
			Graze is collected by being close to bullets.
page_02.text_14:
Earn score by collect blue Point Items, killing enemies,
			and progressing through the game
page_02.text_15:
Spellcards are captured by passing them without losing a life,
			using a bomb, or running out the timer (if not a timeout spellcard)
page_02.text_16:
Power will passively improve the shot based on precentage.
			Focusing while shooting will increase damage further,
			but will also consume power over time.

page_03.text_17:
Recommended mode for casual players.
			Allows saving and restarting at every stage as well as
			guaranteeing the story's good ending. Disables scoring and replays.
page_03.text_18:
Recommended mode for people playing for score.
			Does not alow for saving between stages, but gives a limited amount
			of Continue Credits to continue the game after a game over.
			Complete the game without using a Continue Credit to get the story's good ending.
page_03.text_19:
The Extra Stage is unlocked by completing the Main Story
			on any mode and any difficulty. Each character for the extra stage
			is individually unlocked by completing the Main Story as that character.
page_03.text_20:
The Phantasm Stage is unlocked by completing the Extra Stage.
			The Phantasm stage is accessed by pressing the [shift] key on the
			Extra Stage difficulty select screen 4 times.
